name: Reuben
bio:
Reuben is the firstborn son of Jacob and Leah, the eldest of Jacob's twelve sons. Leah named him saying, "the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me," revealing her longing for her husband's love (Genesis 29:32). As firstborn, Reuben should have enjoyed the birthright and a double portion of the inheritance, but he later slept with his father's concubine Bilhah, a grave breach of family ethics; though Jacob said nothing at the time, in his deathbed blessing he explicitly declared that because of this act, Reuben would "not excel" — losing the honor due the firstborn (Genesis 35:22; 49:3-4).

Even so, Reuben was not without some good in him — in the story of Joseph, it was Reuben who tried to stop his brothers from killing Joseph outright, proposing instead to throw him into a pit, secretly intending to rescue him later — showing that some sense of responsibility and conscience remained in him, even if he often failed to follow through decisively.
